definition: the return of doing things for their own sake, and the ramp that got me there

settled:
My default leisure is progression wearing play's clothes, or watching things. Neither is play.

One day held more real play than most years of the last two decades.

The play is genuinely mine. The girls are not the source of the fun, they are the road to it.

My outward reach runs to them rather than to people, which is what keeps it bounded.

Permission was never the gate. I do not have to justify playing. The two gaps sit inside the act: enjoying it, and starting it.

The scars tax the enjoyment while I play rather than charging a toll at the entrance, so it is medicine I have to file the scar tissue away to receive.

Starting fails two ways at once. Few things cue the activity at all, and when a cue does come I still will not start if I cannot afford the scars.

It comes back one area at a time rather than one game at a time, and each of them lowers what starting costs. I still have to remember to go to her, and I have a system for that now.
